findings.detail: C107 treats source-disclosed negative costs as suspicious even though the extracted cost signs and amounts match the filing schedule.

rationale: Class 1 source confirmation. The filing schedule itself prints negative Cost amounts in parentheses for the flagged unfunded delayed-draw and revolver rows: Klick Inc. has cost (5) thousand at table 38 row 21 and Pipe Bidco GMBH has cost (38) thousand at table 43 row 13. The extracted negative values therefore preserve the raw source; C107 is a monitoring warning whose broad negative-cost predicate is the issue, not the data. No aggregate anchor is relevant.
